title: SimBench-BW calibration / validation / holdout splits
description: Stratified split assignment: 48 calibration / 24 validation / 16 holdout across the 88 benchmark rows, stratified by (domain, level, primary_precision). Calibration grew from 40 (R44 working_set_capacity_sweep + warm_cold_pair_relaunch -> 42; R46 l2_prefetch_hint_sweep -> 43; R47 l2_persisting_window_sweep -> 44; R48 carveout_sensitivity_probe -> 45; dram_streaming_dot_product -> 46; the local-memory family local_dynamic_index_array + local_volatile_array -> 48); validation grew to 24 as the atomics ATOM-vs-RED pairs (.ADD/.MAX/.AND return_used + histogram) and the vector-width copies landed. The producer (splits.toml + verify_coverage.py) wires the counts into the coverage gates; this consumer schema is held in lockstep. Stratification_keys is frozen to exactly those three dimensions in canonical order so the split is deterministic under re-generation. Prediction models use only calibration for tuning; validation is for mid-loop checks; holdout is reserved for final evaluation.

stratification_keys.description: Canonical-order list of the three frozen stratification dimensions.

counts.description: Exact per-split membership counts. (48, 24, 16): the atomics ATOM-vs-RED and vector-width members grew validation to 24, and the local-memory family (`local_dynamic_index_array` + `local_volatile_array`) grew calibration to 48; held in lockstep with splits.toml [counts] + verify_coverage.py.
